mechanism.claim: Opposite completed US cash-session returns in QQQ and GLD identify a rotation between growth risk and defensive monetary metal demand. During elevated BTC variation, follow the QQQ leg for twelve hours after both cash closes are certainly public.
mechanism.side: strict QQQ open-to-close return sign when strict GLD return has the opposite sign
mechanism.why_distinct: Existing candidates use volatility indexes, SPY beta residuals, FX factors, or commodity-volatility indexes. No repository candidate trades BTC from the completed QQQ-versus-GLD cash return rotation, and no prior event/control is promoted.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: completed seven-day BTC variation causal rank at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: NYSE-session rotation events at 23:05 UTC are external and conditional rather than crypto-native Gross9 clocks

features.source: Yahoo chart raw unadjusted QQQ and GLD regular-session daily open/close snapshots, frozen after preregistration
features.session: same official US trading date D, both finite positive opens/closes
features.rotation: strict nonzero QQQ and GLD log(open-to-close) returns with opposite signs
features.availability: D 23:00 UTC, safely after both 16:00 America/New_York regular closes in EST and EDT
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact completed 5m BTC log returns over seven elapsed days ending at decision)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over all daily 23:00 UTC market states, at most 270 and minimum 180; current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: chronological half-open nonoverlap; exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.qqq: Yahoo chart query1=2020-01-01 query2=2026-08-02 exclusive interval=1d events=history
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no source, rotation, side, variation, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
